general.notes: Transmitter optical wavelength per variant is (λ−6.5) to (λ+6.5) nm around center λ from Product Selection (1271, 1291, 1311, 1331 nm). Power dissipation stated as < 1 W (no single numeric W value). Dispersion Penalty (DP) max 2 dB and Transmitter and Dispersion Penalty (TDP) max 3.2 dB are listed without @-condition penalty triplets. Receiver sensitivity −12.6 dBm OMA @ 10.5 Gb/s (BER<10−12, 2^31−1 PRBS, 1260–1355 nm); stressed sensitivity −10.3 dBm OMA @ 10.3 Gb/s per IEEE 802.3ae. Average launch/receive power figures noted informative per IEEE 802.3ae. Module is a limiting receiver (not EDC). POFF (OFF transmitter) max −30 dBm; RIN typ −128 dB/Hz.
